messages.content: Write a long numbered list of synthetic asset names.

cases.title: Client timeout stops a long request
cases.interpretation: Pass means the client gave up at its budget and the run continued. Before the next request, confirm the server has finished; a client timeout alone does not stop server work.

cases.title: Parallel requests are serialized, not stacked
steps: Send two identical short requests at the same moment.
Record both latencies; with one parallel slot the second should roughly wait for the first.
Watch memory pressure and swap on the host while they run.
